fund._note: NOT PUBLIC. `public: false` hides every Fund surface — the nav link, the footer link, the home section, product badges — and stops the /fund route being generated at all. Nothing on the live site claims a donation, which is the point: an unsubstantiated donation claim is deceptive marketing under Competition Act s.74.01, and there is no formal arrangement yet. The intent is kept here because it shapes the brand's reason for existing, and flipping `public` to true is the only change needed to surface it.
